summary: Choose a purposeful impossible relationship and support it with otherwise coherent local visual cues.
objective: The visual contradiction reads as intentional, selected objects remain reachable and factual labels do not silently inherit the fiction.
example_prompts: Create a surreal floating library where stairs become tree branches and the paths remain explorable.

principles: Choose a purposeful impossible relationship and support it with otherwise coherent local visual cues.
This is an authored creative proposal, not a historical definition, fixed template or required rendering library.
implementation: Invert scale, suspend a terrain fragment or blend object categories; keep a few ordinary anchors so the intended surprise remains legible.
Use a palette and light continuity that joins the invented world, or make an intentional light discontinuity part of the stated concept.
Stage the impossible relation from a clear view; use slow transformation or unusual motion to develop the idea without obscuring navigation.
observable_checks: The visual contradiction reads as intentional, selected objects remain reachable and factual labels do not silently inherit the fiction.
Inspect the selected view and an alternate view at the intended output size before accepting the treatment.

creative_affordances: Combine with photorealistic surfaces or minimalist staging; mark invented causal or physical behavior as fictional.
